operators.name: instance_norm_forward
semantics: Compute instance normalization over spatial dimension L for each channel independently, matching nn.InstanceNorm1d with track_running_stats=False.
For each batch n and channel c, compute mean over last dimension: mean = sum(x[n,c,:])/L; then variance = sum((x[n,c,:]-mean)^2)/(L) (biased).
Apply affine transformation if weight and bias are not None: y = y * weight[c] + bias[c].
The operation is elementwise after statistics; no broadcasting issues beyond per-channel scalar multiplication.
Input tensor may be non-contiguous; implementation should handle arbitrary strides by using appropriate indexing or converting internally without changing output semantics.
The output tensor has the same shape, dtype (float32), and device as the input x.
Apply InstanceNorm1d to input x with given eps, affine=True, track_running_stats=False.
Output shape [2048, 64, 512], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
The operation is performed in eval mode; no running stats are tracked.
